evaluation: same-scene development; previous49 all inspected, not independent test
blue_ROI_role: image-guided diagnostic selection, not hidden truth or per-frame method mask
red_ROI_role: diagnostic inferred vehicle/ground conflict, not hidden shape GT
allowed_minimal_controls: fixed-world surface-supported refinement of new road
persistent road-material/representation seam correction after source attribution
prohibited: moving/scaling whole vehicle to chase visibility
stop_rule: one physically motivated refinement plus one justified fallback; keep geometry and colour controls separate; save negative results; no repeated scalar retuning to cross gates
smoke: Any new hour-scale formal fit must have approx10min real environment smoke including checkpoint/eval/full restore/next stage; short forward-only controls separately accounted
